definitions.gloss: head; leader; top official; head of state
definitions.explanation: The top leader or leaders of a country, organization, or political party. Frequently used in political and diplomatic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首脳|しゅのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The leaders of both countries held talks.

examples.japanese: {首脳|しゅのう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}われた→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: Economic issues were discussed at the summit meeting.

examples.japanese: G7{首脳|しゅのう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧し、⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}した→約束する：05643_yakusokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The G7 leaders issued a joint statement and pledged action on climate change.

notes:
USAGE:
{首脳|しゅのう} is most commonly encountered in news and political reporting. It often refers to heads of state but can also be used for leaders of organizations or parties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首脳|しゅのう}⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧ (summit talks)
- {首脳|しゅのう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (summit meeting)
- ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧{首脳|しゅのう} (leaders of various countries)
- {党|とう}{首脳|しゅのう} (party leadership)
- {首脳|しゅのう}⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧ (top leadership group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧: leader (loanword, casual)
- ⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧: leader, guide (broader usage)
- {元首|げんしゅ}: head of state (more formal/constitutional)
